_comment: Example config for nmg. Copy to nmg.local.json (git-ignored) or pass --config PATH. Keys = long options without '--'; command-line values override this file; keys that do not apply to a command are ignored. Never put real secrets here; use secret-env / cert-password-env / account-key-env / sas-url-env / secret-key-env.
_comment_send: nmg send. 'mailbox' is also the mailbox that nmg inbox reads.
subject: nmg test mail
_comment_link: Large attachments as download links (uses the storage settings below): "link-storage": true, "link-threshold-mb": 20, "link-days": 7, "link-text": "Download {0} ({1}, until {2})"
_comment_inbox: nmg inbox: folder = well-known name, folder id or path like Inbox/NAV/Invoices; since = ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
_comment_storage: nmg storage (and send with link-storage / attach-storage). provider: azure-key | azure-sas | azure-entra | s3.
_comment_storage_other: azure-sas: "sas-url-env": "NMG_SAS_URL".  azure-entra: account + container, credential from the auth keys above.  s3: "endpoint": "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com", "region": "eu-central-1", "bucket": "nav-files", "access-key": "AKIA...", "secret-key-env": "NMG_S3_SECRET", "path-style": "auto" (or "on" / "off").  Azurite: "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1".
